SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM drivers d
JOIN lapTimes lt ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
WHERE lt.time IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(lt.time, 4, LENGTH(lt.time) - 4) AS TIME)
LIMIT 20
